reason: I'd throw my guys' nota at the free 30 to see what happens, but I'm not paying until I see it read their scrawled handwritten nota from the supply shop correctly. Right now Excel and my own eyes do the job for free.
objection: The cheating I've actually caught wasn't duplicates or bad sums. It was a nota the shop wrote out with a padded number. A bot that copies the handwriting into a sheet just puts the fake number in a neat row, and then I trust it more than I should.
would_change_my_mind: If it gets my own messy handwritten nota right in the free trial, and it flags prices way above what that supplier normally charges for the same item, not just duplicates.
